title: Chakra linter rules
description: Syntax of rules.toml: one [[rule]] table per check.

x-placeholders.$comment: Master list of message placeholders. Each key is a {name} that a message may use; the value says what the check substitutes. linter.py may supply only these names; tests/linter/test_rules_toml.py enforces it.
x-placeholders.count: Number of items the finding covers, such as nodes, dependencies or attributes. Rendered with thousands separators.
x-placeholders.total: Population size that count is drawn from, such as all nodes, replayable operators or GPU compute nodes. Rendered with thousands separators.
x-placeholders.error: Text of the exception that the protobuf decoder raised.
x-placeholders.type: Numeric node type that the installed Chakra schema does not define.
x-placeholders.version: Version of the installed mlc-chakra package.
x-placeholders.field: Dependency field that holds the cycle: ctrl_deps or data_deps.
x-placeholders.stream: Default stream ID (0) that all collectives use.
x-placeholders.family: Operator or kernel family name, derived from the node name and truncated for display.
x-placeholders.schema: Number of compute nodes that carry an op_schema.
x-placeholders.names: Comma-separated names of the metadata attributes that are absent.
x-placeholders.name: Name of the node attribute that is absent.
x-placeholders.start: Value of the start_ts metadata attribute.
x-placeholders.finish: Value of the finish_ts metadata attribute.

rule.$comment: Unique id and name across rules cannot be expressed in JSON Schema; enforced by tests/linter/test_rules_toml.py and load_rules in linter.py.

id.description: Stable code, letters plus three digits, never reused.

description.description: What the rule checks and why it matters.

message.description: Report text; {placeholders} come from the x-placeholders master list and are limited per rule by linter.py.

exempt.description: Shell-style name patterns exempt from the check (OPS001).
